_comment: ORC-reserved proper nouns that must not appear in any shipped record name or text (spec req 5). Seeded from the chargen-content research pass (verified hits: First World, Abadar, Absalom, Magnimar) plus Paizo's reserved-material statement. This config and attestation waivers are exempt from their own scan; matching is case-insensitive substring over record names and text. False positives get an entry in exceptions with a reason.
